```python
def max_sub_array_sum(arr, n):
    max_so_far = arr[0]
    curr_max = arr[0]

    for i in range(1, n):
        curr_max = max(arr[i], curr_max + arr[i])
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, curr_max)

    return max_so_far
```
